# Pump test decision note

## Decision

Recommend **Option B** for the next prototype. The measured gain is modest, so this note records the assumptions and evidence for colleagues.

## Calculation

For flow $Q$ and pressure rise $\Delta p$, hydraulic power is:

$$
P = Q\,\Delta p
$$ {#eq:power}

See [@eq:power] before comparing the options.
